command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify the staged Sentinel-2 COG against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 8626d4bb645a0ec92ba0099b2c6aab94d0ee328a12ada9190d1c2d0d1771a3f0 B01.tif > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== open the COG and cross-check header against the scene's STAC metadata =="
# Scene S2B_11SKA_20240704_0_L2A (Sentinel-2 L2A, RODA sentinel-cogs). Its STAC item
# declares proj:epsg 32611, proj:shape [1830,1830], transform [60,0,199980,0,-60,4100040],
# uint16, nodata 0. This asserts the fetched pixels/header agree with that metadata, and
# adds a deterministic GDAL band checksum -- the pixel-level decode identity that sha256
# (byte integrity) does not cover.
python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys
import rasterio, rioxarray
from osgeo import gdal
gdal.UseExceptions()
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)

with rasterio.open("/tmp/B01.tif") as s:
    epsg=s.crs.to_epsg(); dt=s.dtypes[0]; h,w,cnt=s.height,s.width,s.count
    nod=s.nodata; tr=[round(v,3) for v in list(s.transform)[:6]]
_ds=gdal.Open("/tmp/B01.tif"); chk=_ds.GetRasterBand(1).Checksum()
rx_epsg=rioxarray.open_rasterio("/tmp/B01.tif").rio.crs.to_epsg()

# each is exact-or-wrong and cross-checked against the STAC-declared value
check("crs_epsg", epsg==32611, f"{epsg}  want 32611 (STAC proj:epsg)")
check("dtype", dt=="uint16", f"{dt}  want uint16 (STAC data_type)")
check("shape", (h,w)==(1830,1830), f"({h},{w})  want (1830,1830) (STAC proj:shape)")
check("band_count", cnt==1, f"{cnt}  want 1")
check("nodata", nod==0, f"{nod}  want 0 (STAC nodata)")
check("transform", tr==[60.0,0.0,199980.0,0.0,-60.0,4100040.0], f"{tr}  want [60,0,199980,0,-60,4100040]")
check("gdal_checksum", chk==55297, f"{chk}  want 55297 (deterministic pixel decode)")
check("rioxarray_agrees", rx_epsg==32611, f"{rx_epsg}  want 32611 (rioxarray reads same CRS)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
